Serve instructions file links from this site (#293)

Remove the 2 site links to site/downloads/cleanlanguage-instructions.md
on GitHub and point the demo prompt at the copy this site serves, so no
page links the GitHub blob or raw URL of that file. The disclosure
page's link to site/_headers on GitHub is outside this change and
stays.

Changes, made in site-src and .github/squash, with site/ regenerated
and never edited by hand:

- site-src/pages/install.html: in the instructions file download
  block, drop the "View the original on GitHub" sentence; the block's
  link to /downloads/cleanlanguage-instructions.md stays.
- site-src/pages/instructions.html: drop the 4th button,
  "View original on GitHub"; the 3 download buttons that this site
  serves stay.
- site-src/pages/demo.html: the prompt reads the instructions file
  from https://cleanlanguage.ai/downloads/cleanlanguage-instructions.md,
  and the callout says it points only at this project's public
  repository and this site's own files.
- site-src/site.json: modified date of the 3 pages set to 2026-11-27.
- site/install/index.html, site/instructions/index.html,
  site/demo/index.html and site/sitemap.xml: regenerated by
  python3 -I tools/build-site.py and
  python3 tools/generate-sitemap.py --write.
- .github/squash/293.txt: add the squash message of this pull request.
